decisions.reason: Data format plug-ins build directly on the firm's existing GIS data format and extensibility knowledge, enabling effective learning and improvement.
Digital twins for building data leverage the firm's GIS and data integration skills but require construction/BIM knowledge outside its core, limiting absorptive capacity and increasing uncertainty.
Authentication and identity delegation is a generic IT security domain far from the firm's GIS core, so the firm lacks related knowledge to interpret early results and improve the product.
An open GIS application development framework is squarely within the firm's core GIS software development capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn and innovate.
Identity and access for GIS applications combines the firm's GIS domain expertise with service integration, allowing it to recognize and apply market feedback effectively.
